messages:
jamal: Heads-up — noticed invoice_preview shows repeated +0.5% token bump for several tenants starting ~2024-06-18 03:00 UTC. Dashboard spike correlates with the new route-enricher rollout.

maria: Which metric exactly? I see a surge in `invoice_preview_delta` for a handful of customers.

jamal: Right, `invoice_preview_delta` (hourly) and the `route_attr_count` in the enrichment stream. Looks like route-enricher started emitting a new `variant` tag and aggregator is treating it as a distinct chargeable route.

kevin: Oof. That was from the lightweight feature flag I rolled out yesterday to add `variant` for debugging. I thought it was non-billable metadata. If aggregator treats it as a route key we're in trouble.

sarah: Can you paste the example event? small sample will help.

jamal: Sure, here's a trimmed event:

```
{
  tenant_id: "acct_123",
  request_id: "req_abc",
  tokens: 450,
  route: "text-gen",
  route_attrs: { variant: "v2-debug", plan: "pro" }
}
```

maria: Aggregator's grouping keys are `tenant_id + route + plan`. Someone must have pushed a change that added `route_attrs.variant` into the shard key during enrichment.

kevin: That was me — I added `variant` to the payload but didn't touch grouping. I'll check the enrichment lambda. If `variant` is surfaced into `route` normalization step it could split shards.

ops: Alert context: console flagged delta > 0.2% for top-100 tenants. Paging window shows 3 consecutive hourly deltas.

jamal: Short-term mitigation: can we patch the aggregator to ignore unknown route_attrs or collapse unknowns into `_unknown`? That should rebind counts to the original `route`.

sarah: Before hotfix, can we also backfill a mapping rule in the router: treat any `variant` values matching `^v\d` as non-billing metadata? Safer to normalize at enrichment.

kevin: I can push a quick rollback of the enrichment change to stop emitting `variant` into the normalized `route` key. But we need a longer migration plan so we don't flip-flop.

maria: Agree. For longer term: add `schema_version` to enrichment events and have aggregator consult a whitelist of fields used for billing grouping. That way adding diagnostic fields won't unexpectedly split keys.

jamal: Proposal:
- rollback enrichment change now (kevin)
- hotfix aggregator to coalesce unknown route attributes for the next 24h (maria)
- introduce `schema_version` and `billing_keys` contract in the event proto (sarah)
- run a dry-run canary: aggregator v2 that emits a flagged-count metric but doesn't affect invoices (jamal)

kevin: Timeline: rollback in next 10m, will post PR. After that I can draft a small schema bump and add `schema_version: 1` to outgoing events.

sarah: I'll open the aggregator PR for the coalesce logic. For canary, we can create a shadow aggregator that writes to `invoice_preview_shadow` and compare counts.

maria: Can we add a console guardrail: when preview delta > 0.1% for > 1h trigger an ops runbook link and temporary mute for noisy tenants? Right now it's just an alert and it's noisy.

ops: Sounds good. Also suggest tagging alerted tenants with `investigation:route-attr` so billing team can spot them.

metering-bot: Replay job scheduled: `replay_ingest 1719232800-1719236400` for tenant subset `acct_123, acct_789` — ETA 45m.

jamal: Good. For audit we need to record the exact grouping keys used at each aggregation version. Add `aggregator_version` to invoice_preview docs.

kevin: PR #452 opened to revert the normalization. Rolling back now.

maria: Aggregator coalesce PR ready for review: link: https://git.internal/r/aggr/pulls/888 — includes whitelist and fallback `_unknown` behavior.

sarah: I'll stand up the shadow aggregator job and a Grafana panel comparing `invoice_preview` vs `invoice_preview_shadow` by tenant. If shadow diverges >0.05% for >30m, auto-fail the rollout.

jamal: One more: we should lock the billing grouping contract in the console (read-only) so non-billing teams know which fields are safe. Maybe a small modal in the route config UI.

kevin: Agreed. I'll coordinate with product to add a `Billing keys` section in the route editor.

maria: Action items documented: https://docs.internal/ops/metering-1719234567 — list owners + timeline.

ops: Closing loop: alert volume dropped after rollback. Will keep monitoring.

jamal: Thanks all. Follow-up meeting in 1h if shadow replay still shows delta.
thread_summary: Root: jamal reports invoice_preview delta after enrichment emitted new 'variant' attr. Team plans rollback, hotfix aggregator to coalesce unknown attrs, add schema_version and billing_keys contract, run shadow canary and dashboard guardrails. Actions assigned to kevin, maria, sarah, jamal. metering-bot scheduled replay.
